title: Lifecycle — Durable Companion checkout enrollment across mount observations
body:
## Closure disposition — 2026-10-18 KST

**Completed: the known durable checkout/recovery-record identity regression is fixed, adopted into the stopped installation, and verified without rebooting the Mac.** The user accepted closing this scope. See the [installed adoption report](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/issues/1457#issuecomment-6243144089) and [old-code reproduction/current-code recovery tests](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/issues/1457#issuecomment-6243545602).

The old service core reproduced the exact device-renumbering failure; the fixed core passed all 9 recovery scenarios and 99 identity cases. A separate disposable native lifecycle test recovered saved work through a fresh Resume after actual owned process loss and cold start.

A physical reboot/remount and production Start/Resume remain **NOT_RUN**. Production remains intentionally stopped. Closure does not claim automatic continuation of an interrupted process or external action.

All sections below are preserved historical records, including their then-current OPEN and runtime-state statements; this closure disposition supersedes those status statements.

---

## Current status — 2026-10-18 KST

**Reboot regression correction merged; canonical source and stopped installation updated successfully.** #1474 and #1476 are merged. Clean canonical main is `8b4dd38b895825885558d454d18323337411c67b`; its tree equals the qualified #1476 candidate. Retained candidate evidence is Full Canonical 16/16 with a separately valid receipt, not a new merge-head run.

The supported stopped installation update and Operator refresh passed. A fresh installed-proxy client confirmed **installed_stopped / exact**; durable enrollment, data bytes, repository hooks and settled recovery history were preserved. The stale #1212 marketplace registration was corrected to the canonical repository through the supported CLI. Earlier failed/refused attempts remain retained.

**Live Start/Resume and a subsequent physical reboot are NOT_RUN. Issue remains OPEN.** See the [complete current reconciliation and preservation report](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/issues/1457#issuecomment-6243144089). No new product patch, Canonical run, migration or model exercise was performed.

The records below retain their original observation dates and describe historical state.

---

## Operational restoration — 2026-10-14 16:10 KST

**Restoration PASS after one explicitly user-authorized startup retry.** The exact merged #1458 source `79a62198d0c0fedc683984299262eca5dc561a7b`, tree `1d1478fdf957e4448dd0863fd165fd076d326bd6` (same as qualified head `382fb5e7`), is adopted cleanly. No later main, product patch or new Canonical run was used.

Supported verified backup and target-copy preparation/recovery rehearsal passed before production preparation. The actual target migration preserves all 136 existing tables' columns/row hashes and 45 canonical records, adding nine empty target tables. Private verified recovery copies are retained. Fresh `install --stopped` enrolled schema-2 durable identity without preparing data at that stage. The first Start exceeded its unchanged 90-second wait; later cleanup evidence saw ready/live, then supported Stop settled it. That failure remains preserved. A separately user-authorized Start retry passed in 18.188 seconds without reinstall, rebuild or timeout extension.

Current installed Companion is **live / exact**, with coherent valid same-binding preservation across actual fresh non-inference stdio discovery (27 tools) and authenticated ordinary Resume (`resolved_exact`, exact source, current work fresh). Transient client/process/streams and fixture cleanup passed; checkout/capacity releases were independently read back absent. Intended production service processes remain running.

Configuration reconciliation establishes that #1458 and #1428 recorded the same exact before/after versions, and only the two unique 107-byte historical task trust sections reproduce the before hash when removed in memory. Writer attribution remains UNKNOWN. The old #1458 preservation FAIL/overall PARTIAL is not repaired or relabelled. A new protected content baseline stayed unchanged through this restoration window; no global config edits occurred. Expected startup continuity-status timestamps changed, with other fields unchanged and no runs/effects created. The separately retained provider/tunnel key was untouched, not read or hashed.

**#1453 consumer acceptance remains NOT_EXERCISED**: launches/envelopes/sends/queries/amendments/reports all zero; ten-minute clock NOT_STARTED. Source qualification, operational adoption and model acceptance remain distinct. No automatic consumer restart, monitoring, issue closure or new PR. Historical device-change cause, failed receipts and trial limitations remain preserved. The dated records below describe their original observation times, not current production availability.

## Historical record before this operational restoration — Post-merge reconciliation — 2026-10-14 KST

**Source implementation and qualification complete; merged through [PR #1458](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/pull/1458).** The user merged the PR at **2026-10-14 14:57:09 KST** (`2026-10-14T05:57:09Z`). Authenticated GitHub reads confirm the PR is closed/merged and no longer Draft.

### Integrated identity

- Verified pre-merge base: `2633ecce6615cdc7b0b3736b4c62f4233659da96`.
- Reviewed and qualified head: `382fb5e796ff1405dfe2893256bf4f91212be40b`.
- Merge commit and main observed at reconciliation: `79a62198d0c0fedc683984299262eca5dc561a7b`.
- Merge parents are exactly the verified base and qualified head. The merge Git tree is `1d1478fdf957e4448dd0863fd165fd076d326bd6`, equal to the qualified candidate tree. No tracked-content divergence was introduced by this merge.

The integrated implementation separates durable Darwin volume/object enrollment from current device/runtime/process observations and source approval; keeps legacy enrollment explicit and atomic; preserves stopped intent; and checks enrollment decision freshness after final preparation immediately before atomic publication. The prior review findings are resolved within this source increment.

### Evidence retained without relabelling

The exact pre-merge head passed **Full Canonical 16/16, including 7/7 Browser**, with a separately accepted receipt (`valid_deciding_evidence=true`, `issues=[]`). Receipt fingerprint: `6128d00d5b9fb25f4d1ce711e51decaef9126c3530768d573a78aa45b55b7bd8`. The receipt remains evidence for that pre-merge candidate and invocation. Matching merge trees is a separate source observation, not a newly executed merge-head test or receipt. This reconciliation did not rerun Canonical or the authenticated Mac validator.

Authorized stale-service retirement and the receipt's scoped absent-service preservation remain PASS. **Overall preservation closeout remains PARTIAL**, with the global Codex configuration comparison FAIL and its changed settings, writer, cause and semantic impact not established by the #1458 closeout. Do not turn merge acceptance into a blanket preservation claim, overwrite the configuration, or relabel historical failures. The historical device-number-change cause remains UNKNOWN.

### Operational boundaries and remaining work

At the last recorded independent maintenance/qualification readback, production was genuinely `not_installed / exact`; no reinstall occurred. This post-merge update does not inspect current Mac state or restore availability. Installation/source adoption, applicable data compatibility and new durable enrollment remain separate operational decisions. The #1453 actual-model exercise remains unexecuted in the submitted evidence: consumer launches/envelopes/sends/queries/amendments/reports are zero and its clock never started.

This is factual post-merge reconciliation only. **Issue #1457 remains OPEN; no issue-state transition is performed.** No source change, production action, database/key access, model run, monitoring or automatic follow-on task is authorized or executed by this update. Direct uppercase Augnes Space editing was not available in this session; no post-merge Space synchronization is claimed.

## Current status — 2026-10-14 KST

**New maintenance and qualification event — 2026-10-14 KST.** The separately authorized stale installed Companion retirement completed through the existing trusted lifecycle owner, with independent genuine absence and required pre-qualification preservation: **maintenance PASS**. Production is intentionally **not installed** until a separately authorized installation/adoption. [Draft PR #1458](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/pull/1458), owned by #1457, now has exact head `382fb5e796ff1405dfe2893256bf4f91212be40b` / tree `1d1478fdf957e4448dd0863fd165fd076d326bd6` on base `2633ecce6615cdc7b0b3736b4c62f4233659da96`: **Full Canonical 16/16, Browser 7/7 PASS**, cleanup/release complete, and separate actual receipt validator valid with no issues. Receipt fingerprint `6128d00d5b9fb25f4d1ce711e51decaef9126c3530768d573a78aa45b55b7bd8`.

**Separate preservation closeout PARTIAL:** global Codex configuration matched immediately after retirement but differed at final qualification closeout (bytes/hash/inode); changed settings, writer, cause and impact remain **UNKNOWN**, with no authentic before-content copy and no speculative overwrite/rebaseline. Source/data and scoped accepted-service preservation passed. This limitation does not turn the valid receipt into proof of blanket global preservation. Historical failures and the unknown device-number-change cause remain unchanged. The consumer exercise is still **NOT_EXERCISED**: launches/envelopes/sends/queries/amendments/reports all zero, ten-minute clock NOT_STARTED. Qualification is not installation, source adoption, model acceptance or merge authority. PR remains Draft/auto-merge disabled; issues remain open. Earlier diagnosis/proposal statements below retain their historical scope.

The install-once Companion currently stores path, a path hash, device and inode as durable checkout identity. A coherent read-only diagnosis found only device differing; the historical cause is unknown. The current safety refusal was correct, but mount-local device identity is not a sufficient long-lived enrollment contract.

Implement a versioned, descriptor-observed Darwin durable volume/object identity and keep active process/run observations strict. Supply explicit, locally authorized legacy enrollment with stale-decision and lifecycle ownership checks; never auto-enroll on status or accept path/inode equality as historical proof. Integrate install, login/start, stop, discovery, maintenance, preservation and retirement. Preserve stopped intent and source/DB authority.

Include real disposable Darwin provider evidence, frozen before/after/lifecycle regressions, truthful typed diagnostics, supported commands and one Draft PR. Qualification must use the unchanged planner and supported executor; the existing production legacy condition may block it. No production repair/adoption, database access, provider/model execution or consumer exercise is authorized.

Coordination: #1453, #1426. Existing diagnostic and qualification histories remain unchanged.
